historical_reviews.deepseek: Directionally aligned on the selector, but its filter cannot validate description, device type, address or address type and its access method is unsuitable for protected evidence.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the right classification and security boundary; its field contract is corrected to the actual Type 34 schema rather than requiring a nonexistent status field.
historical_reviews.history: Exact-code searches found no duplicate variant or earlier completed record.
historical_reviews.v3_1: DMTF Type 34 contains Description, Management Device Type, Address and Address Type after the common header; component/status relationships belong to other structures or external management evidence.

original_test_intent: Verify every SMBIOS Type 34 Management Device structure and its description, device type, address and address-type encoding against the approved platform specification without changing management configuration.
original_method: Preserve existing evidence, collect complete raw Type 34 records through protected read-only OS access, bind them to SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/parser identity, decode the exact standard fields and compare them to the expected device/address matrix with sensitive addresses protected.
manual_activity: The platform/BMC owner supplies the expected management-device descriptions, types, addresses and address-type semantics plus redaction policy; an operator verifies target identity and protected access while automation performs the read-only comparison.
required_inputs: Exact SUT/board, BIOS, SMBIOS and management-controller identity
Expected Type 34 handles, descriptions and management-device types
Expected address values and Address Type encoding for every device
Policy for Other, Unknown, vendor-specific device/address values and zero entries
Sensitive address and target-identity redaction/access-control rules
Supported dmidecode/parser version and protected evidence storage
safety_requirements: Keep the procedure read-only; do not probe or write the encoded management address
Do not change BMC users, network, firmware or management-device configuration
Do not clear dmesg, syslog or SEL before preserving relevant evidence
Never put passwords on the command line or disable host-key verification
Capture complete Type 34 output/status; do not use a heading filter as verdict evidence
Protect management addresses and identifiers while preserving auditable raw evidence
Do not require or fabricate a Type 34 status field; stop on address/schema ambiguity
agent_execution_scope: Validate target, expected Type 34 matrix and redaction rules
Collect complete raw `dmidecode --type 34` through protected access
Parse every handle, description, device type, address and address type exactly
Compare raw address/type encoding to the approved matrix without accessing that address
Optionally correlate separately labelled authenticated read-only management identity
Report comparison and no-change/no-clear audit without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve device descriptions/types and address/address-type mapping
Resolve Other, Unknown, OEM or absent entries
Define permissible redaction and any optional read-only management correlation
Review evidence and own PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Type 34 selector matches the source, but grep hides all substantive fields and sshpass/disabled host checking exposes secrets and weakens identity. The source log-clear boilerplate is rejected.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Through protected access run unfiltered `dmidecode --type 34`, retain complete output/status and decode only Description, Device Type, Address and Address Type per the official schema; do not probe the address or clear logs.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Type 34 scope, SPEC comparison, private script and 10/10-minute estimates remain; evidence-clearing boilerplate is not executed.

modernized_recommendation.status: TYPE34 DEVICE AND ADDRESS MATRIX REQUIRED
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a handle-indexed table of the four Type 34 payload fields, validate address-type-dependent interpretation and compare exact raw/decoded values to the platform matrix under controlled redaction.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds complete schema-accurate parsing, address semantics, secure target binding and evidence preservation while removing GPT V2's nonexistent status field.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A Management Device heading cannot reveal wrong device type, address or addressing method, and an external live BMC status is not a Type 34 field.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The address is descriptive inventory data; accessing it could introduce unrelated I/O or management risk and is not authorized by this testcase.

project_override_considerations: A Project may add authenticated read-only BMC identity as supplemental evidence, but it cannot replace Type 34 decoding or add a status requirement not defined by the selected SMBIOS version. Address probing requires a separate approved case.
expected_evidence: Redacted SUT/BIOS/SMBIOS/management identity, timestamp and approved Type 34 matrix
Complete protected raw Type 34 stdout/stderr and exit status
Parsed handle, description, management-device type, address and address type with raw encodings
Optional separately labelled read-only identity correlation plus no-address-access/no-clear/no-mutation audit
Engineer-owned PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently target SMBIOS Type 34 Management Device information. The extra status field appears only in GPT V2 guidance, not the preserved source, and is corrected by the official schema.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The Type 34 collection and schema-accurate comparison are deterministic once the device/address matrix and redaction policy are supplied.

review_improvement: Replaces filtered unsafe evidence with complete Type 34 decoding and corrects GPT V2's nonstandard status-field requirement while preserving management-address security boundaries.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type 34 is a compact inventory locator: device type is meaningful only together with the address and its addressing method. A generic status observation neither exists in this structure nor proves those encoded relationships, and probing the address would exceed the source's read-only SMBIOS scope.
